author: VanZandtVS
body:
Fux is basically the Beowulf class expert.  It's his chosen class and he sticks with it even though Beo had its own set of problems right now. 

Coming from another less expert Beo main, the best way to beat a Beowulf is to either one-shot them or hope they're not wearing attack status protection and hit them with a double attack down them just kill them at your leisure.

Honestly, the higher you get the easier it's going to be to start taking territory.   By the time you're t10 you'll probably control your town, or at least your section of it. 

Don't worry too much about territory though.  Territory used to contribute a lot to your global rank, but it really has a miniscule effect now.  Ideally you really want to be trading territories back and forth often with your neighbors so you can get the pvp loot, some of which is very nice.

Add VanZandt ingame if you ever need anything.

author: SalamanderofSlippy
body:
I usually try to cheese this by first disabling the opponent by using disabling spells like Sleep Dart or Smoke Bomb, and then using damage over time (DoT)spells like Poison.
This allows even low tier characters to kill high tier characters (assuming the high tier characters aren't immune to said status effects).
This can be done because DoT spells deal damage based on some percentage of the target's health

Oh and also, you have to be lucky and hope that the other guy doesn't have a competent pet or else you aren't gonna deal more than one tick of damage each try because the pet's gonna one tap you
